words.example: Turn on a read receipt when you send the new policy announcement.
words.exampleZh: 发送新的制度通知时，请打开已读回执。

words.example: Sending the roster to payroll produced a delivery failure this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今早把排班表发给薪酬处时，出现了发送失败。

words.example: According to the bounce, her previous mailbox has been closed.
words.exampleZh: 从退信来看，她以前的邮箱已经关闭了。

words.example: Look in the outbox; the announcement has not actually gone out.
words.exampleZh: 看一下发件箱，那份通知其实还没发出去。

words.example: You still have that unfinished notice saved in the drafts folder.
words.exampleZh: 那份没写完的通知还保存在草稿箱里。

words.meaning: 差分服务标记（Differentiated Services Code Point）
words.example: We set DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) EF on the voice VLAN only.
words.exampleZh: 我们只在语音 VLAN 上把 DSCP（差分服务标记）设成 EF。

words.example: Traffic shaping on the guest link keeps streaming from crowding the clinic uplink.
words.exampleZh: 访客链路上的流量整形，是为了不让视频流挤占门诊上联。

words.example: A bandwidth cap on the guest SSID stops one laptop from filling the link.
words.exampleZh: 访客无线上的带宽上限能防止一台笔记本把链路占满。

words.example: The WAN (Wide Area Network) link to the east campus saturated during image transfers.
words.exampleZh: 往东院区传图像时，WAN（广域网）链路被打满了。

words.example: The LAN (Local Area Network) in building C stayed up while the WAN link failed.
words.exampleZh: WAN 链路中断时，C 座的 LAN（局域网）仍然是通的。
